text.feels_intro: How the blood magic in {name} feels right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: flushed dark red, a thin trickle of blood from one nostril.
{name}'s face: blotched purple with burst vessels, blood running from {his} nose and the corners of {his} eyes. The air around {him} smells of hot iron.
{name}'s face: swollen and darkly mottled, blood weeping from {his} eyes, ears and nose, the whites of {his} eyes filled red. A thick stench of hot blood surrounds {him}.
body: {name}'s back: the skin flushed and blotched with tiny red spots where the blood was stirred.
{name}'s back: bruised purple and swollen with blood boiling under the skin, a red sheen of sweat and blood beading from the pores. It smells of hot iron.
{name}'s back: dark, swollen bruises and split skin where blood burst through from inside, blood seeping from every pore and soaking {his} clothing. {name} reeks of blood.
arm: {name}'s {part}: flushed and spotted with burst vessels.
{name}'s {part}: swollen and purple, the veins standing out hot and dark, blood beading through the skin.
{name}'s {part}: blackened with bruising, the skin split from within and bleeding; the limb twitches against {his} will.
leg: {name}'s {part}: flushed and spotted with burst vessels.
{name}'s {part}: swollen and purple, the veins hot and dark, blood beading through the skin.
{name}'s {part}: blackened with bruising, the skin split from within and bleeding; the leg jerks and buckles on its own.

head: {name} feels {his} pulse hammering in {his} skull and a hot pressure behind {his} eyes. {name} is uneasy and keeps wiping {his} nose.
{name} feels {his} blood seething in {his} head, {his} sight swimming red. {name} is frightened and speaks through gritted teeth.
{name} feels as if {his} skull will burst from the boiling blood. {name} is in terror and agony, barely able to see or speak.
body: {name} feels a hot, crawling wrongness in {his} veins. {name} shivers and hugs {reflexive}.
{name} feels {his} blood burning and pulling inside {him}, {his} heart pounding out of rhythm. {name} hunches over, gasping.
{name} feels {his} blood boiling and twisting in {his} body as if it belonged to someone else. {name} is in shock, shaking and helpless.
arm: {name}'s {part} feels hot and twitchy. {name} clenches the fist.
{name}'s {part} burns from within and jerks against {his} will. {name} holds it down.
{name}'s {part} is searing agony and moves only as the blood commands. {name} cannot control it.
leg: {name}'s {part} feels hot and twitchy. {name} shifts uneasily.
{name}'s {part} burns from within and jerks under {him}. {name} stumbles.
{name}'s {part} is searing agony and will not obey. {name} falls when it gives way.

levels: , a sudden hot pressure as the blood stirs beneath the skin. {name} gasps, flushing dark red, a trickle of blood at the nose.
, the blood already disturbed now boiling up again. Vessels burst under {name}'s skin and {name} jerks, blood running from {name}'s eyes.
, and the blood seethes and twists inside {name}. {name}'s body jerks like a puppet, blood seeping from the pores, and {name} screams.
, and it is too much. {name}'s blood boils and tears through the flesh from inside; {name} convulses, bleeding from every opening, and collapses.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

no_attacker_hit.again: is seized by blood magic again and again

head: {name}'s blood boils in the skull; the eyes fill red and burst, blood pours from the ears, nose and mouth, and {name} drops in a jerking heap, the face a swollen purple mask.
the blood magic wrenches {name}'s head back as blood fountains from the eyes and nose; the vessels in {name}'s neck split open from within and {name} falls dead in a spreading red pool.
body: {name}'s blood boils in the chest until the heart bursts; blood sprays from {name}'s mouth and seeps through the skin all over, and {name} collapses, the body slick and steaming red.
the blood inside {name} is twisted like rope; {name}'s body jerks upright like a puppet on strings, skin splitting as blood forces its way out, then drops limp and dead.
arm: the blood in {name}'s {part} boils and bursts out through the skin in a red mist; the magic pulls the rest of {name}'s blood after it, and {name} falls pale and empty in a pool of it.
{name}'s {part} jerks up against {name}'s will as the blood tears it open from within; {name} screams, bleeding from every pore, and dies twitching.
leg: the blood in {name}'s {part} boils and splits the flesh from inside; {name} is wrenched to the ground and bleeds out through a hundred tiny wounds.
{name}'s legs jerk and buckle like a puppet's as the blood magic seizes them; the vessels burst one after another and {name} dies in a widening red pool.

soil: As {name}'s body goes slack, the stink of {name}'s shit and piss mixes with the blood.
In death {name}'s bowels and bladder let go, and the stench of shit and piss joins the smell of blood.
